question: Can any merit truly be compared to the merit gained from worshipping Kālīkā?
premises: The merit of Kālīkā worship is brought into comparison.
The speaker emphatically affirms this as truth.
The speaker explicitly denies any doubt about it.
inference: The merit of Kālīkā worship stands beyond comparison, and this is asserted as unquestionably true.
plain_english: O Goddess of gods, it comes to comparison as truth, truth—there is no doubt.
